scenes.moth: A star-eating cosmic moth. Vast bilateral wings carry concentric eyes, luminous veins, turquoise nebulae and copper dust. Its abdomen is a segmented golden needle and its antennae are branching electrical arcs. Black negative space surrounds the specimen.
scenes.medusa: An abyssal jellyfish carrying the ruins of an observatory inside its translucent bell. Ribbed cyan shell, a luminous amber heart, dozens of impossibly long fine filaments, smaller satellite organisms and drifting plankton. A specimen suspended in black water.
scenes.engine: The uncertainty engine. A turbulent map of imaginary magnetic fields, two luminous whirlpools, woven cyan and copper streamlines, tiny stars caught along the currents, and an empty gravitational wound at the center.
